_comment: Example content matching the original prototype's structure. To use real data instead: export the prototype's data store (listings, hours, brief, settings, ratings) as JSON in this shape, save it as seed/private-export.json, and run the seed script with --from that file.

brief.notes: Financing pre-approved up to €600k loan; Brian and partner will live there themselves. Home office needs one quiet room.

listings.title: Bright Altbau with balcony
listings.vComment: Great light all afternoon. Stairwell freshly renovated. Street side is noisier than expected — bedroom faces the courtyard though.
listings.jjNotes: Agent: Frau Keller (ImmoScout message). Hausgeld statement and the last two WEG protocols requested 11 Oct.
listings.jjComments: The reference point for this search: solid Altbau, fair €/m² for Bergmannkiez. Everything else gets measured against this one.
pros: Classic Altbau, 3.4 m ceilings and stucco
Bergmannkiez location, Marheineke market hall 3 min
cons: Kitchen is 20 years old
No lift (3rd floor is the agreed maximum)
Gas floor heating (etagenheizung) — replacement due in a few years
listings.notes: WEG reserve fund looks healthy at first glance (€48k). Confirm no special assessments planned.

remodel.comment: New kitchen plus repaint throughout; nothing structural.

listings.title: Top-floor flat with roof terrace
listings.vComment: Stunning evening light on the terrace. Finishes from the 2014 conversion still look fresh. Some creaking in the dormer windows during wind.
listings.jjNotes: Offer of €620k submitted 21 Oct via notary draft. Seller's agent hints at a second bidder — do not chase above €635k.
listings.jjComments: My #1. The terrace is a once-a-year find at this price, the 2014 roof conversion means no renovation risk, and Helmholtzkiez matches everything you said about cafés + the park.
pros: Fully renovated 2014, new electrics and windows
cons: Highest €/m² on the board
Hausgeld on the high side (lift, roof reserve)
Second bidder in play
listings.notes: All-in lands just under budget at asking; at €620k there is comfortable headroom.

listings.title: Garden-house Altbau, quiet courtyard
listings.jjNotes: Private sale, commission-free. Owner replies slowly — viewing requested for first week of November.
listings.jjComments: Cheapest €/m² on the list and commission-free, but it misses two of your must-haves (no balcony, 68 m²). Worth one viewing to calibrate the bottom of the market.
pros: Dead-quiet garden house off the street
cons: No balcony (must-have miss)
68 m² is under the 70 m² minimum
Bathroom has no window

remodel.comment: Bathroom redo and floor sanding; kitchen is recent.

listings.title: Renovated Altbau near Boxhagener Platz
listings.jjNotes: Viewing confirmed 3 Nov 17:00 with Herr Brandt (Immowelt). Ask about the 2021 renovation scope — plumbing risers included or not?
listings.jjComments: Strong all-rounder: lift, guest WC, 2021 renovation. The loggia is small — go to the viewing with terrace expectations dialled down.
cons: Loggia is barely 3 m²
East light only in the mornings
Weekend noise from Simon-Dach-Str. nightlife two blocks away

listings.title: Schöneberg classic by Akazienstraße
listings.balconyNote: Balcony to the quiet side street, south
listings.jjNotes: E&V agent contacted 24 Oct; exposé PDF received, floor plan attached to the listing.
listings.jjComments: Just came in. On paper it ticks every must-have and Akazienkiez is the most 'village' of your areas. First floor means checking street noise carefully.
pros: All three must-haves met on paper
Akazienstraße cafés and shops around the corner
Original 1897 details, double doors, herringbone parquet
cons: 1st floor — some street view into the flat
Energy class E, old windows on the street side

listings.title: Wedding up-and-comer with balcony
listings.jjNotes: Under both minimums (64 m², 1 bedroom) — holding unpublished unless Brian wants a price anchor in Wedding.
cons: 1 bedroom only
Under the size minimum

listings.title: Spacious Charlottenburg classic
listings.vComment: Beautiful flat, genuinely spacious — but the numbers don't work. All-in lands ~€63k over budget before any work.
listings.jjNotes: Passed 1 Oct. Keep the agent contact — she gets Lietzensee stock early.
listings.jjComments: Passed on budget, not on quality. If the budget ever moves to €820k, this is the standard to beat.
cons: All-in ≈ €813k — over budget
West Berlin commute to Brian's office

listings.title: Rummelsburg waterside Neubau
listings.balconyNote: South-east, 7 m², water view at an angle
listings.jjNotes: Reduced commission (2.38%). Developer resale, KfW-55 building.
listings.jjComments: The rational choice: nothing to renovate, low running costs, lift, and the bay on your doorstep. Less charm than the Altbauten — view it after one of them for the contrast.
cons: Neubau character — no stucco, lower ceilings
S-Bahn ride to most of your target kieze

hours.note: Initial market scan, 40 exposés filtered to 9 candidates
Helmholtzkiez comparables for the terrace flat
Offer preparation and notary draft for Dunckerstr.

ratings.comment: Loved the light and the kiez. Kitchen budget needed but fine.
The terrace sold me. Let's push on the offer.
Gorgeous but I can't make the numbers work either.

comments.body: If the second bidder goes above €635k I'd rather lose it than stretch — agreed?
General note: after seeing four Altbauten I care more about the quiet bedroom than about stucco.
